relationships.subject: CGRP receptor antagonists
relationships.evidence_quote: administration of CGRP receptor antagonists attenuates mechanical allodynia by inhibiting neuropeptide-mediated signal transmission at the trigeminal nerve terminal

relationships.subject: BDNF
relationships.evidence_quote: suppression of the expression of BDNF and its receptor TrkB in the TG inhibits the development of orofacial pain phenotypes

relationships.subject: MAP kinase inhibitors
relationships.evidence_quote: administration of MAP kinase inhibitors into the TG reverses facial mechanical allodynia

relationships.subject: Trigeminal nerve damage
relationships.evidence_quote: Neuropeptides, including CGRP, are overexpressed in the trigeminal pathway

key_findings: Review: molecular targets in PTNP/PTN animal models include CGRP, BDNF/TrkB, MAPK, Navs, TRP channels, P2X receptors and glia.
CGRP receptor antagonists and PPARgamma agonists proposed for clinical trials in neuropathic orofacial pain.
